name: Olivia Hayes
bio:
Olivia's path to motorsport strategy began with a childhood fascination for racing simulations. She quickly transitioned from virtual circuits to real-world engineering internships, immersing herself in the data-driven world of performance optimization. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, Olivia honed her skills as a race engineer, developing a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics and race strategy.

Known for her meticulous preparation and data-driven approach, Olivia excels at identifying and exploiting strategic opportunities during races. Her calm demeanor under pressure allows her to make critical decisions in the heat of the moment, often turning seemingly impossible situations into victories. She is particularly adept at predicting competitor strategies and formulating counter-measures that give her team a competitive edge. Olivia's demanding personality pushes those around her to perform their best, making her a valuable asset to any racing team.

Olivia's career has been marked by successful stints with several racing teams, contributing to numerous championship wins. Her deep understanding of telemetry data, combined with her ability to anticipate race scenarios, makes her one of the most sought-after strategists in the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often pulled back into a high ponytail during races.
physical.description: Olivia has an athletic build and a sharp, focused gaze that commands attention.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of noise-canceling headphones during races.

Drinks black coffee exclusively, regardless of the time of day.
